{{DISPLAYTITLE:BattlePass}} [[File:S1 battlepass (1).png|thumb|313x313px|Season 1 BattlePass]] The '''BattlePass''' is a seasonal item bundle in Marvel Rivals, which grants the player rewards such as [[Costumes]], [[Nameplates]], [[Emotes]], and [[Sprays]] in exchange for [[Chrono Tokens|'''Chrono Tokens''']] [[File:Chrono Token Currency Icon.png|15x15px|link=|Units]]. == BattlePasses == A BattlePass is released to correspond with each [[Seasons|Season]] and are available for the duration of their season.. The released BattlePasses include: *[[Season 0: Dooms' Rise]] - '''[[Chronovium (Battle Pass)|Chronovium]]''' *[[Season 1: Eternal Night Falls]] - '''[[Darkhold (Battlepass)|Darkhold]]''' *[[Season 2: Hellfire Gala]] - '''[[Flower Of Krakoa (BattlePass)|Flower Of Krakoa]]''' *[[Season 3: The Abyss Awakens]] - '''[[Power of The Phoenix (BattlePass)|Power of The Phoenix]]''' *[[Season 4: Heart of the Dragon]] - '''[[Fruit of Immortality (BattlePass)|Fruit of Immortality]]''' *[[Season 5: Love is a Battlefield]] - '''[[Grand Garden Adventure (BattlePass)|Grand Garden Adventure]]''' *[[Season 6: Night at the Museum]] - '''[[Museum Ticket (BattlePass)|Museum Ticket]]''' *[[Season 7: The Hunt Is On]] - [[Tablet of Life and Time (BattlePass)|'''Tablet of Life and Time''']] *[[Season 8: Sins of Alchemax]] - '''[[Project Heroic Age (BattlePass)|Project: Heroic Age]]''' == Pricing == The '''BattlePass''' has 3 tiers: Free, Luxury, and Upgraded Luxury. The Free tier is free but not all rewards can be unlocked. The Luxury tier costs '''990 Lattice''' [[File:Lattice_Currency_Icon.png|link=|17x17px|Units]] (as of Season 1) and gives access to unlock all of the rewards. The Upgraded Luxury tier costs '''2100 Lattice''' [[File:Lattice_Currency_Icon.png|link=|17x17px|Units]] (as of Season 1) and gives access to unlock all of the rewards, as well as '''2800 Chrono Tokens''' [[File:Chrono_Token_Currency_Icon.png|link=|15x15px|Units]] and a 20% Acquisition Bonus to all '''Chrono Tokens''' [[File:Chrono_Token_Currency_Icon.png|link=|15x15px|Units]] earned. Once a Luxury '''BattlePass''' is purchased, it never expires, so rewards from a previously purchased '''BattlePass''' can be unlocked during a future season if it was not completed. {| class="wikitable" ! style="width:15%" |TIER ! style="width:10%" |PRICE

These prices reflected the season's shorter duration, which was approximately half the length of a typical season, resulting in a correspondingly shorter '''BattlePass'''. == Reruns == Reruns are when a BattlePass from a previous season is made available again for a limited-time at an increased price (at least 20% higher). All of the rewards require purchasing the Luxury BattlePass during a rerun and the Upgraded Luxury tier is not available. The reruns [[Chronovium (Battle Pass)|'''Chronovium BattlePass''']] was made available to purchase again from during [[Season 2: Hellfire Gala|Season 2.5]] from 5/15/25 to 5/29/25 for '''590 Lattice''' [[File:Lattice_Currency_Icon.png|link=|17x17px|Units]]. Other returning '''BattlePasses''' will be priced at '''1190 Lattice''' [[File:Lattice_Currency_Icon.png|link=|17x17px|Units]]. * [[Season 2: Hellfire Gala]] - '''[[Chronovium (Battle Pass)|Chronovium]] Rerun''' (5/15/25 - 5/29/25) ** Priced at '''590 Lattice''' [[File:Lattice_Currency_Icon.png|link=|17x17px|Units]] since the '''[[Chronovium (Battle Pass)|Chronovium]] Battlepass''' was shorter than later BattlePasses * [[Season 5: Love is a Battlefield]] - [[Darkhold (BattlePass)|'''Darkhold''']] '''Rerun''' (11/27/25 - 12/11/25) *[[Season 7: The Hunt Is On]] - '''[[Flower of Krakoa (BattlePass)|Flower of Krakoa]] Rerun''' (4/17/26 - 4/30/26) == Reality Link Point == [[File:Reality Link Point Icon.png|thumb|133x133px]] Previous BattlePasses can be accessed in the Reality Link Point. Go to the BATTLEPASS tab and click the icon in the top right that says NEXUS.
